name: 46402 · Gary, IN
findings: ZIP 46402 (Gary) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46402 (Gary) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46402 (Gary) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
